why: Issue #760's non-finite state: a fuse scaled by a per-tank field that is absent on every shipped tank is undefined/undefined, NaN, and a NaN fuse never reaches zero, so the mine never goes off by itself. Nothing clamps it and the determinism test's hand-picked finite checks do not read mine timers; the generated-scenario finite-numbers invariant walks the whole world after every tick, so every corpus seed that drops a mine reports it with its seed, tick and path.
